parameters.query:
-- Retire items that used up ai_max_attempts, apply retention_days.
SELECT news.sp_housekeeping();

-- Active sources whose poll_minutes has passed (empty when enabled = 0).
SELECT * FROM news.v_due_sources;

-- New items get a status (stale / duplicate / filtered / pending_ai / alert),
-- known URLs are ignored. A non-empty error marks the source as failed.
SELECT $1::int AS source_id,
       news.sp_record_fetch($1::int, $2::jsonb, NULLIF($3, '')) AS result;

-- Up to ai_batch_size pending items + the active prompt.
SELECT c.*, p.version AS prompt_version, p.system_prompt
FROM news.sp_claim_for_ai() c
CROSS JOIN (SELECT version, system_prompt
            FROM news.prompts WHERE is_active) p;

-- Nothing unless a slot from digest_slots is due; sp_digest_begin()
-- claims the slot so it is sent once. One row per digest item, or one row
-- with only digest_id when nothing qualifies.
WITH d AS MATERIALIZED (
    SELECT news.sp_digest_begin() AS digest_id
)
SELECT d.digest_id, i.id, i.source, i.topic, i.title, i.url, i.published_at,
       i.ai_score, i.ai_summary_pl, i.keyword_score
FROM d
LEFT JOIN news.v_digest_items i ON TRUE
WHERE d.digest_id IS NOT NULL;

-- Items stay 'alert'; the slot is retried on the next runs (max 3 attempts).
SELECT news.sp_digest_finish($1::bigint, '{}'::bigint[], $2);

parameters.content:
## News Radar
AI + cyber news → Gemini score 1–5 → e-mail digest.

Sentinel Codex, module `news`. All configuration lives in database `knowledge_hub`, schema `news`, edited on the **codex-news** page (sources, keywords, thresholds, digest times, prompt). Nothing to change here.

Branches run top to bottom on every trigger; each one stops by itself when it has nothing to do.

### 1 · Fetch
Only sources whose `poll_minutes` passed. A failed feed is recorded (`source_state`) and never stops the run.

### 2 · AI score
One Gemini call per run (`ai_batch_size` items), key from Vault `sentinel-codex/api-keys/gemini`. Bad answer = items stay pending and are retried; after `ai_max_attempts` they become `ai_error`.
Model: `MODEL` in *Build Gemini request*.

### 3 · Digest
Sent on the first run after each active slot (08:00 / 13:00 / 18:00 Europe/Warsaw by default). A failed send is retried up to 3 times.
